beats.say: Chun Li actress Callina Liang ate 12 eggs per day to prepare for her role.
The thighs of Callina Liang increased in size by 6.5 centimetres by the end of filming.
Liang stars in the 2026 Street Fighter movie directed by Kitao Sakurai.
She joins a cast including Noah Centineo as Ken Masters.
The ensemble also features Jason Momoa as Blanka and Andrew Koji as Ryu.
This third live action adaptation includes 50 Cent as the boxer Balrog.
